question: Should this command-ledger layer be required to restack cleanly and provide hosted exact-head publication evidence before merge?
rationale: The current dirty stack is not the final merge result, while mutation, deduplication, recovery, and publication boundaries require integration evidence from the ancestry maintainers will actually land.

options.title: Restack And Validate
options.body: Land the dependency, rebase and retarget this branch, then verify real command and requeue receipt publication on the exact head.

options.title: Pause For Contract Changes
options.body: Keep the draft open if review of the foundational dependency changes ledger identity, recovery, or publication semantics enough to require redesign.

recommendation.title: Restack And Validate
recommendation.body: Land the dependency, rebase and retarget this branch, then verify real command and requeue receipt publication on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the ledger stack and the latest replay-identity corrections, making them the best available owner for producing the final ancestry and evidence.
